title: Multiple search inputs collision
body:
I have two input field that searches. First for text search, second search by zip code.
I have added a custom widget for the second input field for search, and I use helper.search(); for manually search.

Steps:
Search result by zipcode => Click on result => click back browser button => I found first input field filled with zip code that I searched for the second input.
That is because query=98072 going internally and when I hit back button it comes back in URL and filled automatically. Please suggest me a solution either send "query" and "q" as the parameter or stop URL filled automatically.
